# Quillote

> Quillote is a tiny code and Markdown editor for macOS, iPhone and Android, with Windows and Linux buildable from the same codebase. It opens local plain-text files and offers three views: Source, Live and Read. The private beta is 0.1.0.

Quillote is built by [Eulogik](https://eulogik.com). Site: https://quillote.com

Key facts:

- macOS DMG: 2.7 MB, Apple Silicon, unsigned private beta.
- Android APK: 7.2 MB.
- Initial JavaScript: 136.5 KB gzipped. App CSS: 4.6 KB gzipped.
- No account, no analytics, no telemetry and no sync service.
- Markdown: Source, Live and Read. Code: Source with around 100 languages.
- Read mode renders tables and KaTeX math. Live mode styles headings, emphasis, code and links; tables and math remain source.
- Themes: Night (default, ink and gold) and Ink (warm parchment). System is an explicit option.
- Crash snapshots every five seconds while the buffer is dirty. Autosave is off on desktop and on for mobile.
- Mobile file model: a picked file is copied into the app sandbox and leaves through the share sheet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://quillote.com/): product overview, interactive three-mode demo, size numbers, platforms and FAQ.
- [Support](https://quillote.com/support/): requirements, known issues, the phone file model and contact.
- [Privacy](https://quillote.com/privacy/): no collection, no cookies, no analytics.
- [Changelog](https://quillote.com/changelog/): 0.1.0 and the next steps.
- [Markdown version of the home page](https://quillote.com/index.md)
